fields.description: The Grove model these sell prices apply to. One Enabled pricing per model; enabling a new one disables it.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: The model's geography, so the pricings of one key — a doc per geography — tell apart. Blank for a model we serve ourselves.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Enabling retires the model's previous pricing; the next push carries it to the gateways, and the pull prices each request at the pricing it was charged. Never disabled by hand and never re-enabled: a wrong price is a new pricing plus a credit row.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: One row per priced counter. A counter with no row here bills 0 — sell rates come from here alone.
fields.label: Rates
